methods.name: Focus
methods.description: Tries to give the control the keyboard focus.
methods.returns: true if the control received the focus.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Activates the control so it can receive input. Inside the Load event it is more reliable than Focus.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Makes the control visible. It is the same as setting Visible to true.

methods.name: Hide
methods.description: Hides the control. It is the same as setting Visible to false.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Marks the control's area as needing a repaint. The Paint event follows when Windows is ready.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Invalidates the control and repaints it immediately.

methods.name: BringToFront
methods.description: Moves the control in front of its siblings in the z-order.

methods.name: SendToBack
methods.description: Moves the control behind its siblings in the z-order.

methods.name: FindForm
methods.description: Finds the form that contains the control.
methods.returns: The form, or null if the control is not on a form yet.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases the resources used by the control. Removing a control from Controls does not dispose it, so call this when it is no longer needed.

methods.name: PerformClick
methods.description: Raises the Click event as if the user had clicked the item.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the item so it is highlighted.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Marks the item as needing a repaint.

methods.name: GetCurrentParent
methods.description: Gets the strip that currently hosts the item.
methods.returns: The ToolStrip, or null if the item is not on a strip.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases the resources used by the item.
